name: Denise Willinger
reason: Health restore, re-checked under the new rule (12 Nov 2026): her own site (denisewillinger.com home, /about, /work-with-me, /virtual-appointment and /contact, read 12 Nov 2026) is pitched first at pain: the home-page headline is aimed at people who have 'tried everything for chronic pain', and her about page says she releases stress and pain 'without spending years stuck in traditional methods that don't work', an indirect claim against conventional care that the owner's rule rules out as a main pitch. The rest is a massage and spa practice (intuitive massage, esthetician services, CEU courses for massage therapists, 'Genius Scan Bioresonance'), with Quantum-Touch sessions and workshops inside it; several pages still carry placeholder text. Skipped because her own main pitch carries the 'where other care failed' claim and the work presents mainly as massage therapy.
